information:
Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2025#60478-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2025#60416-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 20%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2025#60418-associados-aps-aps-associates).
•
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2025#60478-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2025#60416-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 20% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2025#60418-associados-aps-aps-associates).
